title: Audio-Visual Dog Identification and Tracking in Real-World Videos
abstract: arXiv:2610.21011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identifying individual dogs from barks in real-world videos remains challenging and largely unexplored. Solving this problem would enable long-term behavioral analysis, veterinary monitoring, and animal welfare monitoring by attributing vocalizations and behaviors to the correct individual. Real-world videos are challenging because multiple dogs may bark simultaneously, become occluded, or move in and out of view. Prior studies show that canine vocalizations and visual appearance contain discriminative identity information, but these modalities have largely been studied independently. We present a multimodal dog-fingerprinting framework combining visual identification, multiple-object tracking, and canine vocal fingerprinting to associate bark events with individual dogs while maintaining persistent profiles. The framework synchronizes bark events with tracked dogs and updates profiles using visual appearance and vocal characteristics,

translated_title: 真实世界视频中的视听犬只识别与追踪
translated_abstract: 在真实世界视频中通过吠叫声识别个体犬只仍然是一个充满挑战且 largely 未被探索的问题。解决这一问题将能够通过把发声和行为归因于正确的个体，实现长期行为分析、兽医监测以及动物福利监测。真实世界视频的挑战在于：多只狗可能同时吠叫、被遮挡，或进出视野。以往研究表明，犬类的发声和视觉外观包含可用于区分个体身份的信息，但这些模态大多被独立研究。我们提出了一种多模态犬只指纹框架，结合视觉识别、多目标追踪和犬类声纹识别，在维护持续性档案的同时，将吠叫事件与个体犬只关联起来。该框架将吠叫事件与被追踪的犬只同步，并利用视觉外观和声音特征更新档案。
tldr: 提出了一种结合视觉识别、多目标追踪和犬类声纹识别的多模态犬只指纹框架，可在真实世界视频中从吠叫声中识别并追踪个体犬只，并为其维护持续更新的身份档案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multimodal dog-fingerprinting framework combining visual identification, multi-object tracking, and canine vocal fingerprinting to identify and track individual dogs from barks in real-world videos while maintaining persistent identity profiles.
